title: BeyondProd：服務身分、來源證據與網段信任拆解
titleEn: BeyondProd: separating service identity, provenance and network location
subcategoryTitle: 授權語意、相依與一致性
summary: 畫出前端、API、工作程序與資料服務的呼叫邊；每邊記錄呼叫服務身分、建置證據、使用者脈絡與目標操作，將網段欄保留但不作單獨許可。
summaryEn: Draw frontend, API, worker and data-service call edges. Record caller identity, build evidence, user context and requested operation for each edge. Retain subnet as context, while prohibiting subnet membership from independently granting access.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: BeyondProd以多層服務保護降低對網路位置的依賴；本課用合成呼叫圖驗證來源與身分條件，不宣稱重現Google內部基礎設施。
knowledge.textEn: BeyondProd describes layered service protection that reduces reliance on network location. Verify identity and provenance conditions on a synthetic call graph without claiming to reproduce Google infrastructure or assuming every workload in a private subnet deserves the same authority.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 畫出前端、API、工作程序與資料服務的呼叫邊；每邊記錄呼叫服務身分、建置證據、使用者脈絡與目標操作，將網段欄保留但不作單獨許可。
knowledge.textEn: Draw frontend, API, worker and data-service call edges. Record caller identity, build evidence, user context and requested operation for each edge. Retain subnet as context, while prohibiting subnet membership from independently granting access.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 本地准入規則要求身分與核准來源兩項都成立；使用者操作權限另外評估。集合交集只計服務層通過率，不能解讀為終端使用者都獲授權。
knowledge.textEn: The local service gate requires both workload identity and approved provenance. Evaluate end-user operation rights separately. The intersection measures service-layer eligibility only and must not be reported as authorization for every user behind an eligible service.

steps.instruction:

在交接件中加入「BeyondProd · 信任契約與反例資料」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：為本課建立 fixture.csv：每列記錄識別碼、完整輸入、信任來源、預期判定及理由；正常與異常資料都保留。未提供的屬性保持缺值，不可悄悄補成允許值。先寫預期結果，再進行測試，並區分協定要求與自行選定的教學門檻。

Record caller identity, build evidence, user context and requested operation for each edge. Retain subnet as context, while prohibiting subnet membership from independently granting access. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
